extension.summary: Identifies games and fetches their details and artwork from several catalogues
extension.description: Identifies ROMs and disc images by checksum, serial or exact name and gathers their details and artwork. It works offline from the libretro database, downloaded once per platform and refreshed by age, and can also use RetroAchievements, ScreenScraper, IGDB and TheGamesDB when their API keys are entered in the settings. The catalogues are asked in the order you choose; the first one that recognises a file wins, and the others fill in the details and art it lacks.
